en: Sepia-toned photograph of a large open market square bordered by whitewashed arcaded buildings. Many people in traditional North African or Middle Eastern robes gather, trade, and sit with goods spread on the ground. Behind the square rises a densely built hill of flat-roofed houses. At the top stands a tall, slender minaret-like tower next to a small religious structure, dominating the skyline. The overall style suggests an old desert town with Islamic architecture.
